seoTitle: Vick Jeans – Men's Ripped Knee Skinny Jeans | CARBON
metaDescription: Men's skinny jeans in faded mid-blue denim with wide ripped knees, whiskered thighs, copper contrast stitching and one cream belt loop.
descriptionHtml:
Mid-blue denim, faded and whiskered across the thighs, with both knees torn wide open. Small scuffs run down each leg, and copper stitching outlines the pockets and seams.

The detail you notice up close: one cream belt loop at the front. Wear them with a black boxy tee and black sneakers.

  • Skinny leg, full length
  • Ripped and frayed knees
  • Faded, whiskered mid-blue wash
  • Copper contrast stitching
  • Cream front belt loop
  • Button fly

seoTitle: Alex Denim Shorts – Men's Black Ripped Denim Shorts | CARBON
metaDescription: Men's washed-black denim shorts cut to the knee, with two big frayed rips across the thighs and rows of small nicks down the front.
descriptionHtml:
Washed black and broken in all over: two big rips across the thighs with shredded edges, and rows of tiny nicks running down the front. They finish at the knee.

Black tee, black sneakers, done.

  • Washed-black denim
  • Frayed rips across both thighs
  • Allover nick distressing
  • Knee length
  • Front pockets

seoTitle: Memories T-Shirt – Men's Graphic Tee | CARBON
metaDescription: Men's graphic tee with "MEMORIES LAST FOREVER" across the chest in photo-collage letters, with "LAST" in neon pink and yellow. Black or white.
descriptionHtml:
"MEMORIES LAST FOREVER" runs across the chest, every letter packed with photo collage, and "LAST" is picked out in neon pink and yellow so it jumps off the shirt.

Crew neck, short sleeves. The print does the talking, so keep the rest easy: light ripped jeans and white sneakers.

  • "MEMORIES LAST FOREVER" chest print
  • Photo-collage lettering with neon accents
  • Crew neck, short sleeves
  • In black or white

seoTitle: Thank You Hoodie Set – Men's Graphic Hoodie | CARBON
metaDescription: Men's pullover hoodie with "thank you for loving me as your own" in small script on the chest and a large text print on the back. Black or white.
descriptionHtml:
A small script line on the chest reads "thank you for loving me as your own". Turn around and the back says it bigger: "EVERYTHING YOU CAN Imagine is Real".

Part of the Thank You set: pair it with the Thank You Pants Set, which carries the same line down the leg.

  • Script print on the chest
  • Large text print on the back
  • Drawstring hood
  • Kangaroo pocket
  • Ribbed cuffs and hem
  • In black or white

seoTitle: Bradley Jacket – Men's Dark Blue Moto Jacket | CARBON
metaDescription: Men's dark blue moto jacket with a snap-tab band collar, ribbed shoulders and sleeves, an angled zip chest pocket and zip cuffs.
descriptionHtml:
A dark blue moto jacket, kept clean: a band collar with a snap tab, ribbed panels across the shoulders and down the sleeves, and an angled zip pocket on the chest.

Silver zips throughout, cuffs included. Over a black tee with dark ripped jeans is all it needs.

  • Band collar with snap tab
  • Ribbed shoulder and sleeve panels
  • Angled zip chest pocket
  • Centre front zip, zip cuffs
  • Silver-tone hardware
  • Straight hem

seoTitle: Landon Swimwear – Men's Palm Print Swim Shorts | CARBON
metaDescription: Short men's swim shorts in white with a washed-out palm tree print in aqua, lime and pale lilac, and a white drawstring with silver tips.
descriptionHtml:
White swim shorts covered in palm trees, printed in aqua, lime and pale lilac like an old postcard. Cut short, well above the knee.

An elastic waist with a white drawstring threaded through silver eyelets. Add white slides and head for the water.

  • Palm tree print on white
  • Short length, above the knee
  • Elastic waist with white drawstring
  • Silver eyelets and drawstring tips

seoTitle: Kiera Dress – Women's Metallic Ruched Mini Dress | CARBON
metaDescription: Women's high-shine metallic mini dress that wraps into a V at the front, ruched along both sides, with thin straps. In silver, blue or pink.
descriptionHtml:
High shine from every angle. The Kiera wraps across the front into a V, gathers along both sides and finishes in a short, angled hem.

Thin straps keep it simple. Add strappy heels and a small bag and you are out the door.

  • Metallic, high-shine finish
  • Wrap-style V front
  • Ruched sides
  • Thin spaghetti straps
  • Short angled hem
  • In silver, blue or pink

seoTitle: River Top Set – Women's Black Shimmer Crop Cami | CARBON
metaDescription: Women's black crop cami with a fine metallic sparkle running through it, a scoop neck and thin straps. Pair it with the River Bottom Set.
descriptionHtml:
Black, with a fine sparkle running through it that catches the light when you move. Scoop neck, thin straps, cropped just above the waist.

Part of the River set: pair it with the River Bottom Set, the matching mini skirt.

  • Black with metallic shimmer
  • Scoop neck
  • Thin spaghetti straps
  • Cropped, straight hem

seoTitle: Hallie Lace Tank – Women's Lace Trim Cami Top | CARBON
metaDescription: Women's loose, draped cami with lace edging along the V-neck, thin adjustable straps and a V back. In black or white.
descriptionHtml:
A simple cami with one pretty detail: lace edging along the V-neck. Thin adjustable straps, a V at the back, and a loose body that drapes instead of clinging.

Tuck it into wide-leg trousers and add heels.

  • Lace trim along the V-neck
  • Adjustable spaghetti straps
  • V back
  • Loose, draped body
  • In black or white

seoTitle: Nora Flare Jeans – Women's Dark Wash Flare Jeans | CARBON
metaDescription: Women's dark indigo flare jeans in a clean, even wash with no rips, fitted through the hip and thigh and flaring out from the knee.
descriptionHtml:
Dark indigo with a clean, even wash: no rips, no fading. Fitted through the hip and thigh, then opening out from the knee into a full flare.

They sit high on the waist, so a cropped top works well: a knotted tee and heeled sandals.

  • Flare leg from the knee
  • Dark indigo, clean wash
  • Sits high on the waist
  • Five-pocket style

seoTitle: Braided Bracelet C – Men's Double Strand Beaded Bracelet | CARBON
metaDescription: Men's double strand bracelet: speckled grey matte beads with glossy black cubes on one strand, a flat black band on the other, and a black block clasp.
descriptionHtml:
Two strands that sit together on the wrist: one of speckled grey matte beads broken up by glossy black cubes, and one flat black band.

A matte black block clasp joins them. Wear it on its own or stack it next to a watch.

  • Speckled grey matte beads
  • Glossy black cube beads
  • Flat black band
  • Matte black block clasp

seoTitle: Furry Slippers – Women's Faux Fur Slides | CARBON
metaDescription: Women's fluffy open-toe slides with a puffy channelled strap, a thick plush sole and a black CARBON logo tab. In blue, grey or black.
descriptionHtml:
Fluffy all over, from the puffy channelled strap down to the thick, plush sole. Open toe: slide them on and go.

A black CARBON logo tab sits on each strap. Made for slow mornings and quick trips to the door.

  • Faux fur upper
  • Puffy channelled strap
  • Thick plush sole
  • Open toe
  • Black CARBON logo tab
  • In blue, grey or black
